( Temp article)

Symbols and icons of the old [[Tavhiru Dynasty]] would be torn down and replaced with new [[House Un Lie|Un Lie]] symbols. These can still be seen on the [[3rd Imperial Palace of Vurahi|Imperial Palace]], which was torn down and rebuilt after the war. In the late 10thcentury, [[Emperor Vera Zerva Plato|Emperor Vera Plato]] extended the [[Imperial fortress of Vurahi|Imperial fortress]] to defend the city against river invasions from the west, gave Vurahi its first walls between 990 and 1015, rebuilt its bridges to either side of its central island, and paved its main thoroughfares. In 990, he transformed Vurahi's former cathedral school into a student-teacher corporation that would become the [[University of Vurahi]] and would draw students from all of [[Acrohea]].

In 1087 AFA the [[Kaastinial Invasion of Areoix Lie|Kaastinial Invasions]] would reach Vurahi. They would unsuccessfully try to [[2nd Siege of Vurahi|siege and storm Vurahi]]. The Siege is notable for the Death of [[Emperor Vera I]] While leading the Cavalry Charge which broke the siege. After 3 years of war the Invading Armies of the [[Kaastinial Empire]] would be pushed back into [[Ayuman]].

In the 12th century the institutions of central government, which had hitherto followed the Imperial Degrees around the country, grew in size and sophistication and became increasingly fixed, for most purposes at The [[3rdImperial Palace of Vurahi|Imperial Palace]], although the Imperial treasury came to rest in the [[Imperial Fortress]]. While the [[3rd Imperial Palace of Vurahi|Imperial Palace]] developed into a true governmental capital, Vurahi, remained [[Areoix Lie|Areoix Lie's]] largest city and principal commercial Centre and flourished under its own unique administration, the [[Corporation of Vurahi]]. During the 14th century, Cardinal Varanemur, chief minister of [[Emperor Vera IX|Vera IX]], was determined to make Vurahi the most beautiful city in [[Acrohea]]. He built five new bridges, a new chapel for the [[College of Rovavga ( Vurahi|College of Rovavga]], and a palace for himself, the [[Palace of the Emperor|Palace-Cardinal]]. After Varanemurs death in 1392, it was renamed the [[Palace of the Emperor]].

Vurahi grew in population from about 550,000 in 1396 to 1,000,000 in 1525. A new boulevard named the [[Rouve-Varact]] extended the city west to [[Étoile Vurahi|Étoile]], while the working-class neighborhood of the [[Tersin-Rovcoiex]] on the eastern side of the city grew increasingly crowded with poor migrant workers from other regions of [[Areoix Lie]].
